name: @trex/studio
description: Supabase Studio wrapped as a trex UI + function plugin (proxies to a Studio Node sidecar)

scripts.build:static: corepack enable && cd supabase-studio && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && TREX_STATIC_EXPORT=1 SKIP_ASSET_UPLOAD=1 pnpm run build:studio && rm -rf ../build_static && mkdir -p ../build_static && cp -a apps/studio/out/. ../build_static/
